description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different query complexities—Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity categories, labeled “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” appearing in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy,” has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each complexity level, there are two bars representing the two models: NatSQL is represented by a light blue bar, and TA-SQL is represented by a dark blue bar. For the “Simple” category, NatSQL has an execution accuracy of 63.14, while TA-SQL has an accuracy of 60.21; in the “Moderate” category, NatSQL’s accuracy is 48.60 and TA-SQL’s is 39.64; for “Challenging,” NatSQL achieves 32.32 and TA-SQL achieves 36.11; and for the “Total” category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 56.19 and TA-SQL has an accuracy of 51.35. The bars are arranged in pairs, one for each model, for each complexity level, and are not sorted in any particular order. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
